edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner directly from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == ownerCandidate before transferring ownership.
msg.sender is used as the depositor address in deposit.
deposit computes the credited amount from msg.value and multiplier.
multiplier state variable feeds the credited amount computation.
Result of the arithmetic is stored in amountCredited.
amountCredited increases the backlog.
amountCredited increases the caller's creditRemaining.
backlog state variable is mutated by unchecked addition.
creditRemaining mapping entry is mutated by unchecked addition.
Exploiter-controlled msg.sender is pushed into the participants queue.
deposit calls payout, which performs external calls while holding state.
deposit calls withdraw, which performs an external call to weak_hands.
payout reads the contract balance into a local.
Balance is added to throughput.
throughput state variable is mutated by unchecked addition.
investment is derived from the balance snapshot.
payout computes the investment half of the balance.
investment ETH is forwarded into the weak_hands.buy external call.
payout makes an external call to the POWH contract for token purchase.
msg.sender is passed as the referrer argument to weak_hands.buy.
Tokens returned by the external buy are stored locally.
payout computes payoutToSend for the current creditor.
payoutToSend is subtracted from backlog.
backlog state variable mutated by unchecked subtraction.
payoutToSend is subtracted from the creditor's creditRemaining.
creditRemaining mapping mutated by unchecked subtraction.
payoutToSend is subtracted from the participant's owed payout.
participants queue entry mutated by unchecked subtraction.
payoutToSend is forwarded as value in the low-level creditor call.
payout performs a low-level call.value transfer to a creditor.
Reentrant callback during the creditor transfer can alter backlog accounting.
Reentrant callback can manipulate creditRemaining for the creditor.
payout advances the payoutOrder pointer.
payoutOrder is incremented by one without bounds consideration.
withdraw snapshots contract balance before the external call.
withdraw performs an external call to weak_hands.withdraw.
dividendsPaid is computed from the balance delta around the call.
dividends state variable is increased by the received amount.
Reentrant weak_hands.withdraw can distort the dividends accounting.
Owner-only function triggers an external ERC20 transfer call.
tokenAddress user parameter selects the callee of the external call.
tokenOwner parameter is forwarded to the external transfer.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner to reach the external token transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is an input parameter exclusively used by changeOwner.
multiplierPercent is a constructor parameter stored into multiplier.
powh constructor parameter is cast and stored into weak_hands.
aContract only participates in the notPowh guard used by transferAnyERC20Token.
anAddress is only used to index creditRemaining inside amountOwed.
tokenAddress selects the target contract of the external transfer call.
tokenOwner is only used as the recipient of the external transfer call.
tokens is only used as the amount of the external transfer call.
amountCredited is the direct result of the deposit arithmetic unsafe operation.
balance snapshot is a local temporary of the payout function.
investment is the value directly forwarded into weak_hands.buy.
tokens is the local result returned by the weak_hands.buy external call.
payoutToSend is the value directly forwarded in the creditor low-level call.
balance snapshot is a local temporary of the withdraw function.
dividendsPaid is a local computed around the withdraw external call.
